scripts.check: node --check tools/build.mjs && for f in kit/fn/*.js kit/js/*.js hub/functions/api/*.js hub/functions/api/*/*.js hub/functions/*.js hub/functions/a/*.js hub/functions/.well-known/*.js; do [ -f "$f" ] && { node --check "$f" || exit 1; }; done; true
scripts.deploy:hub: npm run build:hub && cd hub && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name 3fs-hub --branch main --commit-dirty=true
